registered_analysis.aggregate_rule: unweighted geometric mean over all 36 main cases; same simultaneous cell interval propagation; also each epsilon/noise/weight/sign stratum
registered_analysis.cost_rule: all shots; also full shot budget for abstention/timeout/error; all baseline qualification must be confirmed
registered_analysis.efficiency_case_rule: all intended main cases, no dropping failed qualification or infeasible cells
registered_analysis.secondary_costs: readout_objects, switches, normalized modeled_device_duration, classical simulation wall time; descriptive only

interval_claim: exploratory development summary; no formal confirmation claim
